The UH-60 Black Hawk is a twin-engine utility helicopter built by Sikorsky, entering service in 1979. It became the U.S. Army's standard troop transport and utility helicopter, with over 5,000 built in many variants — medevac, special operations, search and rescue, and VIP transport — serving dozens of countries.
